claims: Jon Scheyer is the head coach of the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team.
Jon Scheyer took over the head coach role in 2022 following Mike Krzyzewski's retirement.
Jon Scheyer has led the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team since the 2022-2023 season.
Jon Scheyer previously served as an assistant coach at Duke.
Jon Scheyer previously served as an associate head coach at Duke.
Jon Scheyer has achieved an ACC tournament title as a player.
Jon Scheyer has achieved an ACC tournament title as a coach.
Jon Scheyer's full name is Jonathan James Scheyer.
Jon Scheyer was a Duke player from 2006 to 2010.
Jon Scheyer served as assistant coach at Duke from 2014 to 2018 under Krzyzewski.
Jon Scheyer served as associate head coach at Duke from 2018 to 2022 under Krzyzewski.
Jon Scheyer led Duke to an ACC Tournament title in 2023.
Scheyer was named the successor to Mike Krzyzewski.
Mike Krzyzewski led the Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team from 1980 to 2022.
